subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers close or replace this stale local Anthropic Vertex auth-client branch now that current main uses the official Vertex SDK 0.19.0 provider graph, or intentionally sponsor the local-client direction?
rationale: The choice changes auth-provider behavior and dependency ownership, the PR is protected and conflicting, and automation cannot decide whether the local BaseAnthropic/GoogleAuth replacement should supersede the official SDK path.

options.title: Close Or Replace With Current-Main SDK Path
options.body: Recommended: keep the official Vertex SDK 0.19.0 provider graph and close this branch after maintainer review, or open a narrow follow-up only for any remaining live-proof gap.

options.title: Sponsor Local Client Refresh
options.body: Accept the local BaseAnthropic/GoogleAuth direction only with a refreshed branch, provider dependency/shrinkwrap repair, cache-invariant preservation, and live Vertex ADC proof.

options.title: Hold For More Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging until the linked Anthropic Vertex OAuth report is rechecked against current main and the latest release path.

recommendation.title: Close Or Replace With Current-Main SDK Path
recommendation.body: Recommended: keep the official Vertex SDK 0.19.0 provider graph and close this branch after maintainer review, or open a narrow follow-up only for any remaining live-proof gap.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent requested automation on this PR and has the strongest recent routing signal for the provider package/release surface.
